name: reproduce-skill-env
description: Reproduces an exact agent-skill set across machines, teammates, and CI using qvr's portable manifest and lockfile guarantees. Use when a user wants to share, pin, replicate, or CI-gate their qvr skills — e.g. "export my skills", "import this skill manifest", "pin everything to exact commits", "make skills reproducible", "fail CI if skills drift", or "onboard a teammate to the same skills". Covers qvr export/import, --frozen pinning, and the sync --locked / sync --check CI assertions.
